blocks.content: Quiz: Which of the following expressions contains the postfix ++ operator?
Tap an option below to answer:
+rectangle;
Incorrect, give it another shot!
This is an invalid code as the + operator is a binary operator (it takes two operands) and is different from the unary operator ++.
This is an invalid code as the + operator is a binary operator (it takes two operands) and is different from the unary operator ++.
++rectangle;
Incorrect, give it another shot!
Since the ++ comes before the operand (i.e. the rectangle object), this is an example of the prefix ++ operator.
Since the ++ comes before the operand (i.e. the rectangle object), this is an example of the prefix ++ operator.
rectangle++;
Correct Answer!
Since the ++ comes after the operand (i.e. the rectangle object), this is an example of the postfix ++ operator.
Since the ++ comes after the operand (i.e. the rectangle object), this is an example of the postfix ++ operator.
